title: INTERCEPTA Drug Candidate Package: Enzalutamide + Alisertib for NE-escape mCRPC

drug_b.name: Alisertib (MLN8237)
drug_b.mechanism: Aurora Kinase A (AURKA) inhibitor, IC50 1.2 nM
drug_b.status: Phase II completed (single agent failed in unselected CRPC)

item_2_mechanism_of_action.summary: Enzalutamide blocks AR signaling, killing AR-dependent tumor cells. Under AR therapy pressure, a subset of cells undergo neuroendocrine transdifferentiation via AURKA/N-MYC axis, escaping AR dependence. Alisertib blocks this escape route by inhibiting AURKA.
item_2_mechanism_of_action.net_evidence: STRING interaction analysis identifies AR→AURKA as escape pathway
literature: Beltran et al. CCR 2019 (alisertib Phase II)

item_3_predicted_outcomes.model: Unified ODE (80 compartments, 4 states x 20 bins)

combination_NE_high.confidence: From escape route ODE, transition rates estimated

honest_limitations: Transition rates estimated from literature prevalence
Alisertib combo PFS needs PK calibration in unified ODE

item_4_resistance_profile.residual_risk: AR-mutant and AR-V7 populations not targeted by this combination

item_5_combination_rationale.synergy_score: Not applicable — targets different cell populations

item_6_safety_profile.combination_prediction: Overlapping neutropenia expected. Dose reduction may be needed.
item_6_safety_profile.ADMET_computed: Alisertib: LogP=6.01 (high), 1 soft spot, 1 alert (Michael acceptor)

item_7_synthesis.alisertib: Millennium/Takeda. Published synthesis in J Med Chem 2012.
item_7_synthesis.novel_molecules: INTC-002 not synthesized. Retrosynthesis not computed.

item_8_novelty.note: Alisertib single agent tested in CRPC (failed). Combination with enza NOT tested.

item_10_trial_design.rationale: Biomarker-selected population enriches for NE-escape patients who benefit from AURKA inhibition

what_is_real: Escape route biology (AR→AURKA) validated by published preclinical data
ODE predictions validated for docetaxel and enzalutamide
Patient stratification explains known clinical heterogeneity
Not in any registered clinical trial
what_is_predicted: Combination PFS benefit (+10.2mo NE-high) is computational prediction
Transition rates are estimated, not measured
NE fraction at 2 years overpredicted vs clinical data
what_is_NOT_done: Novel molecules (INTC series) have no selectivity
